name: Slot-guided Feature Lifting
definition: A method for learning object-centric radiance fields that encodes scene representations from source views using Slot-Attention, lifts 2D features to 3D to capture fine-grained details, and uses a point-slot mapping to decode 3D representations for rendering color and segmentation masks.
summary: Slot-guided Feature Lifting encodes object-centric radiance fields by lifting 2D features to 3D, differing from peers by computing a single radiance field to reduce training time and memory overhead.
